notes.title: Haloo is now available!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello everybody![/h1]

[h2]We have some big news today as the game is now released![/h2]

Hopefully we see lots of players enjoying the game as much as we have enjoyed making it! There will be discount for the first week as a thank you to the people who have wishlisted the game and supported the development.

In case you have some questions about the game or you want to suggest some improvements or perhaps you found a bug, please contact through our discord channel.


[h2]Happy holidays!

-Ellelel[/h2]

notes.title: Release date announcement!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello everybody![/h1]

[h2]We are happy to announce that the release day of Haloo is finally approaching![/h2]

Lots of work has been done during the last few months to make sure everything is ready for the release. There has been updates and changes made to almost every aspect of the game since opening the Steam store page and we are very excited to share it all with you! 

Key points on what to expect:
[list]
[*] 7 Weapons
[*] 5 Maps
[*] Night and day of every map
[*] 5 Enemy types
[*] 10+ Pickups
[*] Parrot hiding in every map 
[/list]

[h2]Big thank you to everybody who has added Haloo on their wishlist and is looking forward to play the game![/h2]

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello!
It has been busy with the development last couple months and there has been huge steps forward. A lot of the work has been focusing on the gameplay mechanics and weapon visuals, but also some noticeable changes are done to the UI and other aspects.

[h1]GDWC[/h1]
Haloo has been entered to the Game Development World Championship event for Indie game category. There was a big push to get the latest version for the event and also succeeded in that. If you would like to check out the GDWC page, here is the link: [url=https://thegdwc.com/pages/game.php?game_guid=1219eec8-0e01-4d79-a903-980a88b69f55]GDWC Haloo[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983583/ffb6abaf113dc7db86893d55a921c1a6fedfd90c.png[/img]

[h1]Key development points[/h1]
Small and active group of playtesters have been giving great feedback on where to improve. If you would like to give feedback and be a part of the games journey, consider joining the [url=https://discord.gg/T5tg6v2gHX]Discord[/url].

[h2]Enemies[/h2]
Changes to the way enemies move around the map
Changes to the way enemies spawn
Changes to how enemies deal damage
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983583/ef0fa54bf3014adcdef6f04de02ae4470c07ec05.png[/img]

[h2]Weapons[/h2]
7 different weapons
Unique animations for shooting and reloading
New stats for more variable runs
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983583/109d3cb80ddc685660875b5dbef2ba49b7655620.png[/img]

[h2]Maps[/h2]
Changes to map layouts for better balance
New pickups spawn in the maps
Special pickup hiding on every map
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983583/caa141ec4f69344697d446f107bbd90af7f37942.png[/img]

A lot more has been worked on but it will be all revealed later when its more polished and we are getting closer to release date.

Thanks, 
Ellelel

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello, this week has been busy building the steam page and assets for it but I managed to do some updates on the game side also!

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] New layout for Harbor
[*] New Parrot collectable added to every map for a special surprise if you find it
[*] New weather system, you can change weather on level selection for every map
[*] New Supercharged enemies, they are powerful and can end you run
[/list]

[h2]GUI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Font changes
[*] Pickup popups are more clear and visible
[*] Main menu overhauled
[*] Stats container can now be hidden
[/list]

[h2]Settings[/h2]
[list]
[*] New settings menu
[*] Audio settings
[*] Video settings
[*] Added Steam rich presence
[/list]

Join the [url=https://discord.gg/T5tg6v2gHX]Discord[/url] for full update log!

-Ellelel
